description: This file provides utility functions for formatting currency amounts, specifically focusing on consistent display of USD amounts, including dynamic decimal precision and optional appending of credits equivalent for the currency value. It aids in presenting monetary values uniformly across the application with optional credit calculations.

methods.name: formatCurrencyAmount(value, options = {})
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a currency string with customizable options such as currency code, decimal precision, and optional credits label. Handles null and invalid values gracefully and balances readability with precision through dynamic fraction digit calculation.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCreditsText(usd, options = {})
methods.description: Convenience function that formats a USD amount and appends the equivalent credits if the input is valid, utilizing the primary formatting function.
